item.title: Repeal of bus seat belt law shows need for genuine public consultation
item.description: The recent repeal of the government’s legislation requiring us to wear seat belts in buses brings to our attention its policy on and commitment to public consultation. item.title: Tai Po fire: Hong Kong gov’t to offer buy-outs for Wang Fuk Court flats
item.description: Hong Kong authorities announced on Saturday a buy-out offer for owners who lost their homes in last year’s deadly housing complex fire, rather than rebuilding the charred apartment blocks as some residents had hoped for. The blaze, the world’s deadliest residential building fire since 1980, killed 168 people and left thousands homeless in November at […]
